provides: Promo codes and automatic discounts for a Stapel shop. Staff define promotions (percent off, a fixed amount off, or free shipping), scoped to the whole cart, one purchasable type or a list of purchasable keys, with a time window, a minimum subtotal, a stackable flag and usage caps in total and per shopper; codes are many per promotion, case-insensitive, single-use or shared, optionally bound to one shopper, and generated in bulk. Automatic promotions apply without a code. The brick plugs into stapel-orders by Function name only: promotions.quote is the discount adjuster (deterministic, no writes, one adjustment per promotion, free shipping as a marker the shipping adjuster honours) and promotions.reserve/commit/release is the checkout hook that ledgers each use under the promotion's row lock, so two shoppers racing for the last use end as one order and one promo_code_exhausted. Money is Decimal end to end; a discount never exceeds what it applies to.

gates.behavior: true: promotions.release on a committed attempt marks its ledger rows released and emits promotions.redemption.released; false: it answers ok and the rows stay committed.

curated.summary: true (default): when an order that used a promo code is cancelled, the use is returned, so a single-use code works again. false: the use stays spent. Values: true, false.
curated.business_label: Cancelled orders give the code back

extension_points.name: promotions.quote
extension_points.summary: The orders adjuster (kind discount, order 100). Reads context.codes; answers one negative adjustment per applied promotion and promo_code_* errors that refuse the checkout until the shopper removes the code.

extension_points.name: promotions.reserve / promotions.commit / promotions.release
extension_points.summary: The orders checkout hook. Reserve ledgers the promotions the order snapshot grants under the promotion row lock (re-counting caps), commit makes them permanent, release gives them back; all idempotent on the checkout attempt key.

extension_points.name: promotions.codes.issue
extension_points.summary: Mint new unique codes of a promotion, optionally bound to one user and single-use — the reward strategy a referral program calls.

extension_points.name: STAPEL_PROMOTIONS_PROMOTION_PRESENTER / STAPEL_PROMOTIONS_PUBLIC_PRESENTER / STAPEL_PROMOTIONS_CODE_PRESENTER / STAPEL_PROMOTIONS_REDEMPTION_PRESENTER
extension_points.summary: Swap keys (STAPEL_SWAP) for the staff, public, code and ledger presenters.

extension_points.name: promotions.redemption.committed
extension_points.summary: A use became permanent (the order was placed): promotion, code, user, order, amount.

extension_points.name: promotions.redemption.released
extension_points.summary: A committed use was given back (a cancelled order), with the reason.

extension_points.name: promotions.promotion.exhausted
extension_points.summary: A promotion reached its total usage cap.

requires.reason: comm bus (promotions.* Functions and facts, user.merged consumer), AnchorPagination, GDPR owner protocol, AppSettings

calls promotions.quote as its discount adjuster and promotions.reserve/commit/release as a checkout hook once stapel_promotions.preset.SETTINGS_DEFAULTS is in STAPEL_ORDERS; without orders the staff API, validate endpoint and Functions still work
per-shopper caps are keyed on the user id; user.merged moves a guest's uses to the account on sign-in
